name: Joash
bio: Joash was of the clan of Abiezer, Gideon's father, who kept an altar to Baal in the city of Ophrah. The LORD commanded Gideon to tear down his father's altar by night and build one to the LORD instead; when the men of the city discovered this and demanded Joash hand his son over for execution, Joash replied, "Are you going to plead Baal's cause for him? ... If Baal really is a god, he can defend himself when someone breaks down his altar" — and so Gideon came to be called Jerubbaal, meaning "let Baal contend" (Judges 6:25-32). Joash's shrewd reply not only saved his son's life but delivered a sharp public mockery of Baal's powerlessness. After Gideon died, he was buried in his father Joash's tomb at Ophrah (Judges 8:32).
